text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — ACME kickstart workshop scheduling. Customer is 3-seat pilot, onboarding health flagged yellow due to delayed prework. Need to lock 90-min workshop + two 30-min office hours over next 2 weeks. Who can host and who needs to prep materials?

josh_se: I can host the workshop (90m) next Wed or Fri morning PST. Will need SE support for live demo and config Qs.

ariana_pm: Noted. Their CSM noted customers are CET and APAC — can we offer two office hour slots at varied times? one CET-friendly evening, one APAC-morning?

maria_cs: Yep. Proposed windows:
```
- Workshop (90m): Wed 2026-05-07 09:30 PT / 18:30 CET
- Office hour A (30m): Mon 2026-05-12 17:00 CET (good for EMEA)
- Office hour B (30m): Tue 2026-05-13 09:00 AEST (APAC morning)
```

sam_solutions: I can join for the demo on the workshop and run the quant/cost tradeoff section. Need the model config and an example prompt set by EOD Monday to prepare.

maria_cs: @sam_solutions I'll ping the customer for the sample prompts. Also asking product for any short checklist we should send as "prework" — it's crucial to get them from red -> green.

ariana_pm: Agenda sketch for the 90m workshop: intros (10m), onboarding checklist & network setup (15m), demo + model routing examples (25m), hands-on guided prompts (25m), next steps & renewal touchpoint (15m). We should call out renewal risk: they hinted at budget review in 6 weeks. Add a short slide about ROI and cost controls.

josh_se: Good call on ROI. I'll draft a one-pager: "expected token cost ranges + batching/cache wins" and drop in the shared drive.

maria_cs: Logistics: can someone create calendar invites and include Zoom + recording on by default? Also set RSVP and an internal host-only rehearsal 30m before.

sam_solutions: I'll create the invites and include the rehearsal. Will add join link and a checklist in the invite body.

ariana_pm: Post-session feedback: we'll run a 3-question survey (usefulness, blockers remaining, renewal intent signal). Can we automate survey send via HubSpot 24h after session?

maria_cs: Yes, CS automation team can do that. @deploy-bot please remind to trigger the HubSpot sequence after the workshop.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: trigger HubSpot NPS+followup 24h after 1715098765 workshop event. :white_check_mark:

josh_se: Also: capture short recording clips of the demo steps (2-3 min each) and upload to shared enablement folder — helps asynchronous users.

sam_solutions: Will record and clip. Also adding a short Loom walkthrough for the prework steps.

ariana_pm: Action items summary (quick):
- maria_cs: confirm times with customer and collect sample prompts (by Mon EOD)
- sam_solutions: create invites + rehearsal + record clips (by Tue)
- josh_se: one-pager ROI + cost controls (by Tue)
- ariana_pm: slides + survey template for automation (by Tue)
- deploy-bot: schedule HubSpot survey trigger

maria_cs: Perfect — if all agree I'll confirm times with the customer and update this thread. If they decline these windows we fallback to next-week same-day equivalents. :thumbsup:

ariana_pm: Agree. Also add a short line in the invite about recommended network ports/whitelisting prework. Fewer friction points during session.

sam_solutions: One last ask — please include account health tags in the invite: migration-risk:medium, renewal-window:6w, prework-status:pending. Helps support triage during workshop.

maria_cs: Will include those tags in the invite metadata. Thanks everyone — will update thread after customer confirms.
